summary: Run the unfolding (exists_isAdmissibleComb_unfolding) up to the definite space Y_m with S(q) = the pure tensor of the evaluated data at the cosets q; the last stage is a matrix coefficient of the paired chain (unfoldStage_even) and pairs with the restriction map R (exists_last_stage_map). The resulting w, scaled by c·a, is an admissible, invariant combination of reduced vacua (exists_isAdmissibleComb_reducedVacuum), whose paired chain is the definite chain of a good datum (exists_isGoodDatum_of_invariant). Here c = normUnit(a·C/cutBound^{2m}), a unit of ℂ (normUnit takes unit values, also at 0); when a·C ≠ 0 it clears the constant a·C and the denominator cutBound^{2m}.

steps.claim: Choose C and hC: one C for every tame character ϑ (n = levelNorm ϑ) and every tuple y integral away from n, such that ⊗_i evaluatedDatum(ϑ, y, i) is an admissible combination of the C·D.reducedVacuum(t), t ∈ admissibleTranslations(n), with denominator cutBound^{2m} and, if Q(ϑ) = ∅, size 1.

Choose the restriction map R on forms of stage m, the criterion B (equality of the two chains after R gives ι_ϑ(y) = B^Ψ(φ)) and, for each functional t, a constant c(t) with A: the coefficient t of ψ, paired with a form x on Y_m over the rational Bessel points, is c(t)·⟨x, Rψ⟩ (exists_last_stage_map).
steps.lean: choose R B c A using D.exists_last_stage_map D.m_eq_two_mul_varrho_add_two

steps.claim: For every ξ choose T(ξ) and H from unfoldStage_even at i = ϱ (the last pair, x = 1): stage m at the points of the last grading is the coefficient T(ξ) of the paired chain chain₂(liftKernel ϑ, evaluatedDatum(ϑ, y), ϱ + 1)(φ); T(ξ) does not depend on ϑ, φ or y.
steps.lean: choose T H using (unfoldStage_even · _ .refl _ (by simp [pairEvalY]; rfl) 1)

steps.claim: Apply exists_isAdmissibleComb_unfolding with k = m = 2ϱ + 2, the last grading (string length 0) and a = c ∘ T: one constant a ∈ ℂ, chosen before the quantifiers over tame characters ϑ, modules M and maps S, and, for each ϑ, M and S, the vector w with admissibility s₁ (denominator 1 and, if Q(ϑ) = ∅, size cutBound^m), invariance s₂ and the period formula G.
steps.lean:
choose a w s₁ s₂ G using D.exists_isAdmissibleComb_unfolding _ le_rfl
    (D.lastGrading D.m_eq_two_mul_varrho_add_two) (by omega) (c ∘ T)

steps.claim: Take c = normUnit(a·C/cutBound^{2m}), a unit of ℂ (normUnit takes unit values, also at 0). For a twist ϑ, let w be the vector of step 4 for S(q) = ⊗_i evaluatedDatum(ϑ, rep(q), i): a vector of the tensor space of finite data. Binding s₁ with hC (evaluatedDatum_out: only the cosets matter) makes w an admissible combination of the C·D.reducedVacuum(t) with denominator cutBound^{2m} and, if Q(ϑ) = ∅, size cutBound^m; normUnit_smul (which needs only cutBound^{2m} ≠ 0) makes w′ = normUnit(a·C/cutBound^{2m})·a·w an admissible combination of the reduced vacua with denominator 1 and, if Q(ϑ) = ∅, size cutBound^{2m}·cutBound^m = cutBound^{3m}. By exists_isGoodDatum_of_invariant (its invariance hypothesis left as a goal, step 6) there is a good datum Ψ such that, for every smooth form φ on X₀, the paired chain of lifts with datum w′ (TensorChain.lift of liftInPairs(liftKernel ϑ)) applied to φ equals chainComb(ϑ, Ψ, translateDatum, m)(φ): the equality holds after the paired lift is applied to the vector w′, which is not itself a chain. Then ι_ϑ(𝒫(c·φ)) = B^Ψ_ϑ(φ) by the criterion B of step 2, once liftChainY(ϑ, m)(𝒫(c·φ)) = R(chainComb(ϑ, Ψ, translateDatum, m)(φ)); by the equality above the right side is R(paired lift of w′ applied to φ), and the equality of the form on Y_m with R of the definite chain is tested against every vector Ξ (ext_inner_left).
steps.lean:
refine ⟨normUnit (a * C / (D.cutBound ^ (2 * D.m))), fun ϑ ↦ (D.exists_isGoodDatum_of_invariant ϑ
    (.normUnit_smul a NeZero.out ((s₁ fun q ↦ pure (evaluatedDatum ϑ (q · |>.out)) _).bind _ 1 fun
    y _ ↦ by simpa [evaluatedDatum_out] using hC ϑ _ (y · |>.2))) fun b a ↦ ?_).imp
    fun Ψ ↦ .imp_right fun e φ ↦ B (.trans (ext_inner_left ℂ fun Ξ ↦ ?_) congr(R $(e _)))⟩

steps.claim: Invariance: the joint action of b ∈ ∏ D.columnLevel with b_m = 1 fixes the vector:
steps.lean:
· simp; congr; apply s₂ _ b
    simp only [← Quotient.mk_smul_out, evaluatedDatum_out, twoKernelAction, TensorChain.map_pure]
    clear * - a
    exact fun q ↦ (pure_congr fun i hi ↦ by cases hi <;> simp (disch := lia) only [evaluatedDatum,
      translatedUpsilon, *, smul_eq_mul, ← Prod.mk_mul_mk, map_mul, pairEvalY, Module.End.mul_apply,
      dite_eq_left, dite_eq_right] <;> apply_rules [ArrowPair.finEval_inclXFin, map_one]).symm

steps.claim: it suffices to apply s₂ to the linear map induced by twoKernelAction(b);
unfold it on pure tensors of evaluated data at coset representatives;
steps.lean: simp only [← Quotient.mk_smul_out, evaluatedDatum_out, twoKernelAction, TensorChain.map_pure]

steps.claim: for each pair i, the action of (b_{2i}, b_{2i+1}, b_{2i+2}) on evaluatedDatum is evaluatedDatum at the moved points, because the finite evaluation commutes with the finite points (ArrowPair.finEval_inclXFin; cases i < ϱ and i = ϱ).
steps.lean:
exact fun q ↦ (pure_congr fun i hi ↦ by cases hi <;> simp (disch := lia) only [evaluatedDatum,
      translatedUpsilon, *, smul_eq_mul, ← Prod.mk_mul_mk, map_mul, pairEvalY, Module.End.mul_apply,
      dite_eq_left, dite_eq_right] <;> apply_rules [ArrowPair.finEval_inclXFin, map_one]).symm

steps.claim: The test against Ξ (an algebraic form on Y_m): apply G with the form z = conj(Ξ) (of the conjugate type on Y_m), the ramified column φ and L = ⟨Ξ, R(paired lift of · applied to φ)⟩, a linear map on the finite data. Its hypothesis holds by H (stage m is the coefficient T(ξ) of the paired chain) and A (that coefficient paired with Ξ over the rational Bessel points is c(T(ξ))·⟨Ξ, R(…)⟩). So ⟨Ξ, liftChainY(ϑ, m)(𝒫(c·φ))⟩ = ⟨Ξ, R(paired lift of w′ applied to φ)⟩ after scaling: the chain on Y_m is paired with Ξ directly, while R acts on the definite chain (R is defined on forms of the definite space X_m, not on the Y-chain).
steps.lean:
simpa [inner_smul_right] using! G _ ⟨_, Ξ.2.conj⟩ φ (innerₛₗ ℂ Ξ ∘ₗ R ∘ₗ lift
    (TensorChain.liftInPairs (D.liftKernel ϑ · |>.lift)) φ (_ + 1)) fun ξ y a b _ ↦
    (A _ Ξ (by simpa [a] using! H ξ ϑ φ y b)).trans (by simp [evaluatedDatum_out, chain₂])
